steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Well, that was an unfruitful day...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I never had such headaches back at the agency in Lungmen.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Because Mr. Liang left you no leads to follow?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: No, it's actually because... I have a lot of friends in Lungmen.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: And aside from Mr. Liang the shut-in, the only friend I have in Shangshu is you, Master Shen.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: There's a crowd at his door, isn't there?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Doesn't look like they're trying to be discreet.

steps.name: Suspicious Passerby
steps.text: Hey, the Lungmenite's here too. Right... Don't be rash. Just don't let them get away.

steps.name: Suspicious Passerby
steps.text: Keep an eye on them.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Eh, I don't suppose we walked into their trap?

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Weird... It doesn't matter how glorious they were in the old days, they're just a bunch of restaurateurs now. Do they really have this much influence?

steps.name: Odd Traveler
steps.text: There's no one else around—W-Wait!

steps.name: Suspicious Passersby
steps.text: M-Master Shang.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: I'm here.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: H-Have a seat. Would you like some tea?

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: I asked around.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: There are a few spots that fit the description. Very few visitors, but there are some pavilions that have been around for a while. I marked them on the map.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: As for your wine shops, wherever there's a settlement, it's practically guaranteed that there's one. These places fit the bill.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: There's one at Qujiang Peak?

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: I have no idea myself, but Old Qian insisted that there is.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: These are all out-of-the-way trails. No normal sightseers would go there. Be careful.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I see. Thank you, Master Shang.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: I will take my leave, then...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Master Shang, do you know those men outside the door...?

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Don't know them.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Goodbye.

steps.name: Suspicious Passerby
steps.text: What's going on...?

steps.name: Suspicious Passerby
steps.text: (Tell the innkeeper... Master Shang and the Lungmenite have dealings with each other!)

steps.name: Odd Traveler
steps.text: (Should we still block the way out here?)

steps.name: Suspicious Passerby
steps.text: (What the hell are you even trying to block? Let's go! We're out of here!)

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: You're back.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: That trip was a complete waste. Please don't ask.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I'm just worried about bandits coming after you.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: As long as you're looking out for me, they won't make trouble.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: What's more, our hot little goblet isn't in my possession anymore. You should be careful yourself.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: No need.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: We found out who ambushed you. It's all a misunderstanding. They thought you were a smuggler pillaging artifacts.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Well, it sounds like Shangshu's chivalric code is alive and well. That was quite the brawl for a minor 'misunderstanding.'

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Don't blame them.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Master Shen, Lee isn't a local. I'm afraid I'll need you to take care of him for the next couple of days.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Of course, it's not big deal.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I know things are hectic at the docks lately. I'll pay you double your wage for your time.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Don't worry about it, Mr. Liang. We never talk money.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I can't do wrong by my citizens.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: You've been a great help, and I might need more of your help in the future.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Fine, then... If that's how you feel, then I won't push it.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: I'll stick with our boy Lee for as long as he's here. Those of us who make a living on the mountain trails and rivers know the Three Mounts and Seventeen Peaks like the backs of our hands.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: —Liang Xun.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: What's the matter?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: We'll talk inside.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I remember telling you that as long as you aren't hiding anything from me, this will be nothing complicated.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Tell me, what exactly is the story behind the cup and its master?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: You can't tell me?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I ran into those guys again in the mountains today.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: So that little 'misunderstanding' of yours isn't actually very convincing.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: How high are the stakes?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: As high as heaven.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: You should've told me sooner.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I was afraid you'd get dragged into the mess if you knew too much.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: So you still think I'm not part of the mess?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Forgive me.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: You should get some rest. If our friend proves too difficult to locate... then you don't have to worry about it.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: We've come this far. You can't suddenly have second thoughts about this, can you?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I appreciate the feeling, but if I really call it quits here, that's the end of the good life for you. I know that much.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: So what's on the table? You can at least tell me that, can't you?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Both the people and the country.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Well, the stakes do sound high, and it's such a tall tale, I'm finding that kind of hard to believe.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I would never joke about such a serious matter.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Of course I know you wouldn't.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Let me change the subject, then. You wouldn't be entertaining a lovely lady this evening, would you?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: —*Cough*.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: There is nothing between me and Miss Ning.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I never said there's anything between you two.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Your eyes said enough.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Really? Everyone always ridicules you for how unsociable you are, but even Huai Tianpei's girl is all grown up now. You have to have scored a home run at least once or twice?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: You have your reasons, huh?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: How about a drink?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: It's high time we had a drink together.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Right... We're long overdue.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You truly are a swift one, Miss Kroos. The innkeeper wasn't kidding.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Where is the man with the fan?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: We couldn't risk a complete wipeout in case you had any traps set up here, can we?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: How peculiar... I thought you would send him, while you hide in the shadows.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: As the saying goes, one should sacrifice a pawn to save one's queen. Not only are you the 'queen,' you're a crossbowman and an escape artist.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Even so, you came personally.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Well, my mate Nothing isn't a regular operator yet. I can't just have him fly into the face of danger.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: And yet you still have a mind for danger, especially when you have to go it alone, don't you?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: If you're the kind of bloke who goes all 'I can see right through you' just to seem smart, I'd rather go home and have a sleep.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Haha... so temperamental. Forget I said anything, then.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I'll get to the point. We've looked into Rhodes Island a little. With so little time, we didn't dig up a lot of information.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I don't claim to fully know you, but at least know you can be trusted.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Can I? Not only did I butt my head into this affair, I'm an Infected, you know?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You must put the right people to the right job. Oripathy is a misfortune that all Infected face. What does that have to do with their responsibilities or skills?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I would like Rhodes Island to do us a favor.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: No, in fact, if you don't help us, then I'm afraid you'd be making an enemy of us.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: You want Mr. Lee's goblet.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: When I chased the thief that night, right away, the tracks split into two. It was dark out, and you moved quick, but I never took my eyes off the one who'd actually left the Liang estate.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I lost them not long thereafter, though. And then a certain someone showed up, just like it was a planned diversion—

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: The innkeeper drew my attention. Was he drawing it away from you?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: No wonder he thinks so highly of you.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Bingo, eh?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: What does the cup have to do with ‘Sui?'

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You know of 'Sui?'

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Oh... Looks like you're not lying, though you know only half the story.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Hm, is that so?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Considering you see Nian and Dusk as friends... and that she told you about this much, they must see Rhodes Island as a lifeline of sorts.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: In years past, so long as they stayed in line and broke no rules, the Sui Regulator would turn a blind eye to whatever they did.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: But nowadays, things are different.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Not only are the times changing, you are on friendly terms with Nian, and you even brought Dusk off her mountain. That put you on the Sui Regulator's wrong side.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: We were just...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I know you meant no ill will, but what comes next?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: How is Great Yan meant to know that they are not planning anything when they are all in one place?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: 'Great Yan...'

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I'm not trying to exaggerate.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Nian and Dusk disappeared not long after they reached Shangshu, and it just so happens that a goblet associated with them made its way here around the same time. Furthermore, the man of the hour is on Rhodes Island's side.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: This is a tremendous coincidence. Wouldn't you say so, Miss Kroos?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: And I'm not one to believe in coincidences.

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: Oof!

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: I forgot to hang the clothes to dry. Oh no, oh no... If I don't get to that now, there won't be anything to wear tomorrow.

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: Shang Zhong, huh? You shouldn't have come.

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: Now get lost. I'll pretend I didn't see you.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: There was a young man who asked me to look for a pavilion in the mountains.

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: We all know things were complicated when you left, but not only did you leave us without an explanation, you even set the innkeeper up. Going by the rules, that makes you a traitor.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Then your men surrounded him.

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: Please, traitor, Brother Shang, I'm begging you. If anyone sees us, things will get hairy. Let's put a stop to this.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Who is that man?

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: Brother Shang!

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: I'm asking you, who is that man?

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: The Lungmenite...?

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: It's all business. It's got nothing to do with outsiders, and I have nothing to tell you.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: It'll be ten full years at the end of this one. I've been thinking of giving the Association an explanation soon.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: I'll give all of you an explanation.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: I'll settle the score with Zheng Qingyue.

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: I still can't tell you, Brother Shang!

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Liu! Who pulled you out of the fire all those years ago?!

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: I can't say.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: It has to do with the goblet, doesn't it? The cup from ten years ago?

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Bingo, then...

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: So that's the 'goblet' the kids have been talking about...

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: Hey, you didn't interrogate any of the young disciples, did you—

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: This must be fate...

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: —Hey, Shang Zhong! Don't just leave after you got that answer from me! Our years of friendship mean nothing to you, huh?! Hey!

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Hah, looks like you're a better drinker than you used to be.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: The Liang Xun of the good old days would probably be curling up into a ball under the table right about now.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I drink by myself every now and then.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Well, that's our Magistrate Liang. You find the time to drink even as a government official—Hold on, you drink by yourself every now and then. That doesn't mean what I think it means, does it?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I drown my sorrows. It's human nature.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: They say that it takes a personality change to build your tolerance for alcohol. Wise words, don't you think?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: It's a fair point.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: *Sigh*... When we drown our sorrows, it's a whole myriad of relationship we're trying to drown.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: To tell you the truth, I was actually pretty surprised when I saw you again.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Hm? Why is that?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: The Liang Xun I know is a methodical, taciturn fellow.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I remember that time in school, outside the Chamber of Teachers Emeriti, when you said you were going to bless all under heaven. You said the world's a harsh, cold place, so you'd build a fire to warm everyone up, and they would never know darkness again.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I was just spouting words. We were young. Perhaps those were the exact words that led me to reflect on myself now.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: It was years ago.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Many years ago.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: You aren't the refined young master you used to be either.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Time flies, and I frittered all mine away.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: It's been a long time since you left home. Have you spoken to your family?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: It hasn't been that long since I left home.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: You're saying that detective agency in Lungmen is your home now?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: What about back in Jiangdong?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Jiangdong, or Kong Tung as we call it, is just a place with a house, some lanterns, and a few old friends.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: We've both changed.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I hope that when we clink our glasses together, it's not the sound of our past ambitions crumbling away that we hear.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: No, no, no, that's not quite right. You're a mandarin of some standing and the magistrate responsible for a city. If the masses are happy with you, perhaps you've already achieved your dreams?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: We still have a long road ahead of us. Shangshu has always been a bustling place. What I'm trying to accomplish is just gilding the lily.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I hope that you won't forget who we once were, then. Gon bui.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Gan bei.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Seems like Yan's research into occult mysticism is the greatest secret across this whole world.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You make it sound like we don't want to share.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: They may take different forms, but all nations approach the same problem in their own way. Everyone faces this issue.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Though, because of certain... historical reasons, Great Yan's Sui Regulator happens to be at the forefront of 'Feranmutology.' Always has been. Always will be.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Kjerag still worships them as gods and Sami attempts to coexist with them, but the Sui Regulator's research has advanced to unparalleled heights.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: So, the 'Sui' in Sui Regulator is the same 'Sui' that Nian talked about?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Did Nian tell you about those legends? The old emperor, the wild hunt, and what they uncovered?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: (That's the stuff Lava talked about...)

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: In ancient times, the people thought of certain creatures as 'gods,' and with civilization's advancement, they gradually began to go into hiding.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The 'Sui' is one such creature.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: 'Certain creatures...?'

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Whether they actually meet the definition of a living being is up for debate, and I don't suppose we need to go there.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: All you need to know is that when at last they come to bring destruction to the world, Yan has the power to annihilate them. That's all.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Fair enough...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: This is not exactly confidential Sui Regulator information, but it's not exactly common knowledge either.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I'm telling you all this not because I want a scholarly discussion.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Nian, Dusk, and the one who's in hiding somewhere in Shangshu. All of them are under the Sui Regulator's surveillance.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Normally, these things would not happen at such a pace. But then one day, the clouds all dissipated from that mountain. By the time the Sui Regulator Candleholders arrived, Dusk was nowhere to be found.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: That happened just a few days ago.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: It took only a few days for the Candleholders to brief the court on this matter too.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: That's something... There's quite a bit of distance between Mount Hui-ch'i and the capital, isn't there?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Rhodes Island is getting itself involved without knowing the whole picture. The ignorant are blameless. On the contrary, it's unimaginable that you would work with those two without knowing anything.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: And now, we would like Rhodes Island to follow the Sui Regulator's arrangement and persuade the Lungmenite to surrender the goblet himself.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I knew it... Liang Xun was under your thumb the whole time.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Correct.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: He had Mr. Lee deliver the cup all the way from Lungmen to be stolen, and it's all a show, huh?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You call the magistrate by name, but gave the Lungmenite a courtesy title. That shows you are a good person.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Does being a good person mean anything else in Yan?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Please don't get the wrong idea. I'm not trying to beat around the bush. All I'm saying is that you aren't hiding your trust in the Lungmenite anymore. Is it because of his partnership with Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: It's actually more than that... He's a friend too.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: There aren't many people we can truly call friends. It seems Nian and Dusk are your friends too.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: It sounds like the Sui Regulator has some high standing in Yan. So why the ruse? Who are you trying to fool?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I'm afraid that's more than what Rhodes Island needs to know.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: And you straight up admit that?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: There's nothing to hide. It's just a more elegant way to go about this to save our mandarins some face.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Now that I've told Rhodes Island so much, can we set aside our differences and negotiate?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: You want our help?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: We'd like Mr. Lee's too.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: What do you need help with?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The elimination of the Sui.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I'm not drunk. No need to hold me like this.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: You're my guest.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I'm just a grunt you summoned from Lungmen.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I actually considered the possibility that the Messenger might not be able to find you in Lungmen.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: And I actually registered my agency in Lungmen hoping that you would find me.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: 'Lee's Detective Agency.' Why did you choose to build your business in Lungmen, though?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: It's the farthest away I could get from Yan.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Any farther than that... I have no place to go.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: You could come back.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I don't want to.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Liang Xun.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I know, actually.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: You always knew.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Lungmen is not your home, yet you spent half your life holding out hope for Lungmen.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I thought, there, I could finally find what it was that I wanted to do.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Did you?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I did, but I also found that I could find it just about anywhere.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: All those years ago, Huai Tianpei said he'd study kung fu and make a name for himself.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: And all those years ago, Liang Xun wanted to do something for all people under heaven, to change the ways of the world such that they would no longer have to be afraid.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: What about you?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I was just a finbeast in a river, and the moment I jumped a few chi out of the water, I felt I was at the top of the world.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Okay, I'm pooped. I've got a long day ahead of me tomorrow. You should get going.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Take care.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: There's no more wine...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: *Sigh*.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Old friends, old friends...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: An Indistinct Dream
steps.text: ...A brilliant move.

steps.name: An Indistinct Dream
steps.text: I see that I'm losing. I suppose there is no need to continue?

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: There is no need to continue.

steps.name: An Indistinct Dream
steps.text: There are more to the four arts than weiqi, and yet that's the one you always pick to challenge me. This is a form of bullying.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: One man must avoid one's shortcomings.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: And we both know I am no match for you in poetry and song.

steps.name: An Indistinct Dream
steps.text: Fair.

steps.name: An Indistinct Dream
steps.text: Lost interest already?

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: These are times of peace.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: Though these times of peace are enjoyed only by Yan.

steps.name: An Indistinct Dream
steps.text: Your stones are set only in Yan.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: Correct. The board is entirely within Yan's borders.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: Though I am not necessarily playing every round. In that case, the other games must take place elsewhere in the world too.

steps.name: An Indistinct Dream
steps.text: Will those games have aught to do with you?

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: Real men remain silent as they spectate and never regret their moves.

steps.name: An Indistinct Dream
steps.text: So all you do is spectate. You watch mankind as they wage wars and battle with each other.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: I'm just learning the art of the game by spectating. Even children start to play by imitating.

steps.name: An Indistinct Dream
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: An Indistinct Dream
steps.text: But you are not him.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: An Indistinct Dream
steps.text: You... Oh, you are one of his pieces.

steps.name: An Indistinct Dream
steps.text: Will you play in his stead, then? Mr. Lee of Lungmen?

steps.name: An Indistinct Dream
steps.text: Hoh... This is peculiar.

steps.name: An Indistinct Dream
steps.text: Why did he drag an ordinary man like you into this game?

steps.name: An Indistinct Dream
steps.text: No, perhaps he didn't choose you in particular. He simply realized that things would come to this sooner or later, no matter who and no matter what?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: What are you talking about?

steps.name: An Indistinct Dream
steps.text: I'm saying you are not the disheartened man, but you are sitting here in his stead, playing a game with me.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Who are you...?

steps.name: An Indistinct Dream
steps.text: Ling.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: What is this place?

steps.name: An Indistinct Dream
steps.text: A dream... from a hundred years ago.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Now that's funny. How could I have a dream that takes place a whole century ago...?

steps.name: An Indistinct Dream
steps.text: Indeed...

steps.name: An Indistinct Dream
steps.text: How could you?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Hmm... It feels like I had quite the dream... Oh?

steps.name: Voice Outside the Window
steps.text: Stop right there!

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: That voice...
